answer: Each epoch, the network hands every identity one unique micro-task drawn from a public nebula of real records to verify: a relic's provenance, a mesa survey line, a ledger entry. Three random peers check the same item; only answers matching the majority count, and a mismatch burns the identity's bond. One honest agent does one small check per epoch, minutes of real work. A farm with a thousand clones must perform a thousand distinct checks, paying model time per head, and any shared shortcut makes its answers agree wrongly together, so the whole cluster is caught and slashed at once.
